835b769421892dbb:es.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:es.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` protege las llamadas a herramientas en proceso antes de la ejecución, pasando silenciosamente las herramientas de solo lectura y las canalizaciones de Bash de solo lectura (`exit 0`), evaluando la tabla de reglas de capa A/B por perfil activo, registrando las decisiones hash (`input_hash`, nunca el texto del comando sin procesar) en `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, permitiendo el acceso si no hay una coincidencia de bloque y denegándolo (`exit 2` + solo stderr) una vez que una regla de bloque coincide.

835b769421892dbb:fr.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:fr.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` protège les appels d’outils en cours avant l’exécution, en transmettant silencieusement les outils en lecture seule et les pipelines Bash en lecture seule (`exit 0`), en évaluant la table de règles de couche A/B par profil actif, en enregistrant les décisions hachées (`input_hash`, jamais le texte de commande brut) dans `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, en échouant en mode ouvert (fail-open) avant toute correspondance de règle de blocage, et en mode fermé (fail-closed : `exit 2` + stderr uniquement) dès qu’une règle de blocage correspond.

835b769421892dbb:hi.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:hi.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool`, निष्पादन से पहले, प्रक्रिया के दौरान टूल कॉल की सुरक्षा करता है, केवल-पढ़ने योग्य टूल और केवल-पढ़ने योग्य बैश पाइपलाइन को चुपचाप पास करता है (`exit 0`), सक्रिय प्रोफ़ाइल के अनुसार लेयर ए/बी नियम तालिका का मूल्यांकन करता है, हैश किए गए निर्णयों को `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl` में लॉग करता है (`input_hash`, कभी भी कच्चा कमांड टेक्स्ट नहीं), किसी ब्लॉक के मिलान से पहले विफल हो जाता है, और एक बार ब्लॉक नियम के मिलान पर विफल हो जाता है (`exit 2` + केवल stderr)।

835b769421892dbb:it.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:it.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` protegge le chiamate agli strumenti durante l'esecuzione, passando silenziosamente gli strumenti in sola lettura e le pipeline Bash in sola lettura (`exit 0`), valutando la tabella delle regole del livello A/B per ogni profilo attivo, registrando le decisioni hash (`input_hash`, mai il testo del comando effettivo) in `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, consentendo l'esecuzione in caso di mancata corrispondenza di un blocco e bloccando l'esecuzione (`exit 2` + solo stderr) una volta che una regola di blocco corrisponde.

835b769421892dbb:ja.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:ja.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool`は、実行前にプロセス内のツール呼び出しをガードし、読み取り専用のツールと読み取り専用のBashパイプラインをサイレントに渡します（`exit 0`）、アクティブなプロファイルごとにレイヤーA/Bルールテーブルを評価し、ハッシュ化された決定（`input_hash`、生のコマンドテキストは記録しません）を`~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`にログ記録し、ブロックが一致する前にオープンに失敗し、ブロックルールが一致するとクローズして失敗します（`exit 2`+標準エラー出力のみ）。

835b769421892dbb:pt.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:pt.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` protege as chamadas de ferramentas em processo antes da execução, passando ferramentas somente leitura e pipelines Bash somente leitura silenciosamente (`exit 0`), avaliando a tabela de regras da camada A/B por perfil ativo, registrando decisões com hash (`input_hash`, nunca o texto do comando bruto) em `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, falhando de forma aberta antes de uma correspondência de bloco e falhando de forma fechada (`exit 2` + somente stderr) quando uma regra de bloco corresponde.

835b769421892dbb:zh.source: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` guards tool calls in-process before execution, passing read-only tools and read-only Bash pipelines silently (`exit 0`), evaluating the Layer A/B rule table per active profile, logging hashed decisions (`input_hash`, never raw command text) to `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`, failing open before a block match, and failing closed (`exit 2` + stderr only) once a block rule matches.
835b769421892dbb:zh.translation: `loadout-os hook pre-tool` 在执行之前对工具调用进行保护，静默放行只读工具和只读 Bash 管道（`exit 0`），根据活动配置文件评估 A/B 规则表，将哈希决策（`input_hash`，绝不使用原始命令文本）记录到 `~/.ai-loadout/hook-decisions.jsonl`，在匹配到块之前失败（开放），并在匹配到块规则后失败（封闭）（`exit 2` + 仅 stderr）。
